_doc: Hero road spec (ARCH_OPTIONS HR1, MAP_REPAIR.md 'Hero roads'). DRAFT from P0-019: the layout comes from reference photos found online, the widths are read from the photos by scale cues (a car is about 1.7 m wide and 4.3 m long, a person about 1.7 m tall) and are not surveyed. The spec overrides OSM tags and class defaults for the ways it covers; the bake never changes a hero road's cross-section on its own (rule R-HERO). Every field names the photos it was read from (ids in refs). Photos are reference only: never copied into the game or the repo.
name: Connaught Place, Inner Circle

covers.note: The closed way 'Inner Circle' (tertiary, junction=roundabout, lanes=3 in OSM on 2026-11-11). The spec says 4 lanes: it overrides the tag.

traffic.sense: clockwise seen from above: Central Park is on the right of the direction of travel, the colonnade blocks on the left

crossSection._doc: Left to right in the direction of travel (colonnade side first). width in metres per lane, raise in metres above the carriageway. The drive lanes are centred on the OSM way.

lanes.surface: stone paving in front of the colonnade, bollards at the kerb
angled parking bay between the footpath and the planter
kerbed planter with a clipped hedge between the carriageway and the parking bay
asphalt, white dashed lane lines, solid white edge line on the park side
flower bed between the kerb and the park footpath
stone paving with a tactile strip

kerbs.note: on the park side directly at the carriageway; on the colonnade side around the planter and at the footpath

left.note: colonnade side, widened in the 2010 to 2013 renovation

right.note: Central Park side, behind a flower bed

colonnadeEdge.note: the column line stands at the back of the left footpath; behind it a covered walk, above it the first floor
colonnadeEdge.style: two storeys, white render, Tuscan columns on the ground floor, windows above, a parapet; arched pavilions at the block ends

treeLine.species: large deciduous street trees (semal and others), in pits in the paving; uneven spacing

parkEdge.type: green steel railing on a low plinth at the back of the park footpath

poses.note: standing in the flower bed on the park side, eye height, looking across the carriageway at the colonnade blocks, slightly along the road. The exact spot on the circle is not known from the photo.
